sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/h-cooper-black/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 27 sites') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/ (statewide park filter attributes for H. Cooper Black: data-maxrv=91), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (843-253-5124). Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/h-cooper-black/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/h-cooper-black/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights'), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC agency row

summary: Confirmed 27 W/E sites, showers, dump, 14-night max; added sewer + 50 A (24 'Full Service' sites on the calendar, booking-site filter), max rig 91 ft (booking-site filter), and SC's 13-month window and 2-night minimum. Open to any RV camper: the camping page says 'RV Camping: Yes' with no horse/dog requirement. Fees left as read 2026-10-11. Not stated: season, pull-throughs. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: policy_ref is 'none', but the area books on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site under the same policies as the other state parks (13-month window, 2-night minimum, 14-night max, same cancellation rules): the state:SC row looks right for it, consider removing policy_ref:none.
Phone 1-866-345-7275 is the statewide reservation line; the park's own number is 843-253-5124 (southcarolinaparks.com/h-cooper-black).
note: SC State Parks field-trial and recreation area near Patrick (Chesterfield County). Built for sporting-dog field trials and equestrians (stalls, trails, retriever fields) but open to any camper. Busy during field-trial events. --Claude
